sources.excerpt: Official Chang Chang site identifies the Washington, DC restaurant at 1200 19th Street NW, Washington, DC 20036.
Official FAQ defines Chang In dinner, Chang Out weekday lunch/carryout, weekend dim sum, and warns fried gluten-free dishes may have cross contamination.
Restaurant-issued allergy guide names item-level shellfish, dairy, egg, nuts, sesame, soy sauce and wheat disclosures and states shared fry oil cooks wheat, shellfish, allium, nut and mushroom items.
Official current Lunch & Dinner image menu surface for Chang In dine-in service.
Official current dessert image menu surface.
Official happy-hour drinks and bites surface, with food bites in scope and alcohol excluded.
Official weekend bottomless dim sum surface, Saturday and Sunday 11:30am-3pm.
Official beverage surface states a spirit-free dine-in program; spirit-free drinks are in scope and alcohol is excluded.
Official carryout surface links the location-specific pickup provider and image menu.
Restaurant-linked Toast catalog for Chang Chang DC at 1200 19th Street NW lists the live Chang Out food and dessert inventory.
Official-domain document, sitemap, PDF, image, nutrition, ingredient, FAQ, allergy and downloadable surfaces inspected; the official /allergies guide was found.
Targeted domain and restaurant/location searches located the official allergy guide and current official menu surfaces.
